titles.title: Break Free From Plastic Pollution Act of 2023
Break Free From Plastic Pollution Act of 2023
Protecting Communities from Plastics Act
titles.titleType: Short Title(s) as Introduced for portions of this bill

titles.title: To amend the Solid Waste Disposal Act to reduce the production and use of certain single-use plastic products and packaging, to improve the responsibility of producers in the design, collection, reuse, recycling, and disposal of consumer products and packaging, to prevent pollution from consumer products and packaging from entering into animal and human food chains and waterways, and for other purposes.
